notes.title: ♣ Le Jacques Noir : The table of Illusions ♣
notes.notes:
[p]We pulled out of the truck a battered plank, two wobbly trestles, and an eight-folded ticket so nothing falls apart.
And just like that, we pulled off the impossible: [b]Le Jacques Noir![/b] 🎩[/p][p]Settle under the flickering neon and brace yourself:[/p][list][*][p][b]“Ultra-realistic” Deal[/b] 📥
The cards slide in slow-mo to give you time to count… and realize you’re as bad at math as you are at luck.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Up to 3 Hands at Once[/b] 🤹
Triple your bets, triple your hopes… and triple your defeats.[/p][/*][*][p][b]LuckyLucky Bets[/b] 💀
Let’s be honest, you’re more likely to catch the bubonic plague from a churro than hit 777.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Seb Tested It[/b] 🕹️
Roughly speaking: cards that stick when you split and double-downs with ever-shifting geometry.[/p][/*][/list][p]A massive thank you to everyone contributing on the hub 🙏—your feedback is the fuel for our madness.
The ducktape stock is holding strong: keep sending your wildest ideas for the next round of chaos! 🎉[/p][p]UwU 💋[/p]

notes.title: 🛒 THE GRAND BAZAAR 🛒
notes.notes:
Oh, this is different, huh?
You thought we’d let those zebras run for free forever?
The age of freebies is over. Welcome to the marketplace.

[h2]🛒 THE SHOP IS OPEN FOR BUSINESS![/h2]

Now you can buy and sell like a true merchant of illusion.
Zebras? Scratch tickets? Fingers sore from too much scratching?

    [i]We’ve got you covered. It’s all good stuff.[/i]

Zebras don’t spit out money directly anymore. You want profit? Go sell them. Time to work for it !

[h3]🧾 MISSIONS?[/h3]

Now they hand out scratch tickets.

    [i]Scratch them, sell them — but whatever you do, just lose.[/i]

[h2]🏆 New achievements (or humiliations, depends on your point of view)[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]ALL IN[/b] – Sometimes you gotta lose everything at once to earn respect.
[*] [b]TILT[/b] – You shook it too hard, cousin.
[*] [b]Dumpster Diver[/b] – No poor shaming brother. Sometimes you gotta fall before you bounce.
[/list]

[h2]🛠 FIXES – THE BARE MINIMUM[/h2]

[list]
[*] Switching tabs in the journal no longer freezes your destiny. And we capped it at 100 lines. Nobody wants your life story.
[*] Wheel of Fortune: x2 now stacks. Twice the chance… to fool yourself.
[*] Skipped missions are now logged. About time, right?
[*] Wheel lighting adjusted. You see it better now? So do we.
[/list]

You wanted something new?
We gave you better: [b]the illusion that any of this will change your fate[/b].

notes.title: 🎡 SHAKE IT BABY! 🎡
notes.notes:
You asked for it. You dreamed of it. You screamed it at your screen like a madman:
[b]“Shake the machine, dang it!”[/b]
Well… now you can.

[h2]🪙 The Coin Pusher – SHAKE IT![/h2]

One button. A real one. Big. Red. Juicy. It vibrates.
You press it — everything shakes. Coins wobble. Physics panics.
And maybe — [b]JUST MAYBE[/b] — some of it will fall.

It’s like elbowing the machine in real life, but legal.
[i](Well... in the game.)[/i]

    [i]Don’t go abusing it, alright? You don’t want problems, cousin.[/i]

[h2]🎰 Slot Machine – NERF TIME[/h2]

[list]
[*]     Now with [b]5 bet levels [/b](used to be 3 — we're generous like that)
[*]     Jackpot now triggers [b]no matter the bet[/b] — even at 1 coin
[*]     Jackpot now scales with your multiplier (!)
[/list]

Go ahead, take your shot with next to nothing.
It’s like a real casino, except here you’ve got [b]even less chance[/b] to win.

[h2]🏇 Zebra Race – ALL IN[/h2]

[b]Save time. Lose everything faster.[/b]
You asked for it, and here it is: the ALL IN button.
A single click to ruin it all.

    [i]Don’t press it. Really. Don’t listen to your friends.[/i]

[h2]📜 Dear Diary – I'M BROKE[/h2]

Now you can revisit every glorious moment of your downfall!
Relive every poor decision and reflect on the utter futility of your choices.

Don’t worry — [b]we don’t log anything when you dig through the trash.[/b]

    [i]Your dignity is safe. (For now.)[/i]

[h2]🛠 Bugfixes – BUG ≠ SCAM[/h2]

[list]
[*] No more mini-freezes when the soundtrack changes. [i]We taught the jukebox a lesson.[/i]
[*] Ghost texts when scene-loading too fast? [i]Exorcized.[/i]
[*] "Keymaster: collect scratchcard" mission is [i]finally behaving.[/i]
[*] Coin Pusher kept eating your coins while stuck? [i]Nah. Check again.[/i]
[*] Roulette ball escaping the table ? [i]We installed fences. It should stay. Should[/i].
[*] Key clipping through prizes in Keymaster? [i]We glued the collisions back together. Fingers crossed[/i].
[*] And for the 1% of you who couldn’t stack more than 2,147,483,647 coins:  [b][i] We fixed it. Now you can get even richer — and we love that.[/i][/b]
[/list]

Now go on.
[b]Shake It.
Don’t be shy.[/b]

notes.title: ⚙️ MAJOR UPDATE FOR A MINOR OPTIMIZATION ⚙️
notes.notes:
Stop everything. Put down your soda, push your cat off the keyboard, and take a deep breath.
[b]Funfair Billionaire just got a FPS boost. Yes, seriously. This game.[/b]

[b]🪙 COIN PUSHER POWER-UP[/b]

✅ Coin Pusher now running at 120 FPS (unless your PC runs on hamster power).
✅ No more crashes when spamming coins like a maniac (yes, we tested).
✅ Suspiciously smooth gameplay — we honestly thought we were dreaming.

[b]😱 WARNING: THIS IS NOT A DRILL[/b]

We’re not sure how it happened. Cosmic alignment? Maybe we finally read the Unity documentation.
Who cares? What matters is that, for the first time in project history:
[b]The game is slightly less of a disaster.[/b]

[b]🎩 Conclusion:[/b]

Did we fix all the problems? Absolutely not.
Are we celebrating like we just won a Nobel Prize? [b]Of course we are.[/b]

Thanks for surviving with us through this buggy journey.
We’re still working on optimization — a little, a lot, or at random.

notes.title: 🦓 THE ZEBRA RACE IS HERE 🦓
notes.notes:
Some devs fix bugs.
Some devs improve performance.
[b]We add zebras. Lots of zebras.[/b]

[b]🦓 THE ZEBRA RACE: PEAK NONSENSE 🦓[/b]

It all started with a "brilliant" (read: catastrophic) idea from our player [b]Dragonfly[/b], who thought:
"[i]Hey, what if you made a zebra race where you have zero control and can lose everything?[/i] 😂"

We could’ve ignored it.
We could’ve been responsible.
But instead, we said: [b]"ABSOLUTELY GENIUS."[/b]

Here’s the deal:

[olist]
[*] Bet every last fake dollar you’ve got on a poorly animated zebra.
[*] Pray it doesn’t immediately crash into a wall.
[*] Watch the chaos unfold, powerless but weirdly entertained.
[/olist]

[b]Nothing makes sense. Everything is unfair. It’s beautiful.[/b]

🎠 Dubious animations included.
🎲 Sadistic RNG approved.
💸 Virtual bankruptcy inevitable.
🥲 Personal satisfaction not guaranteed.

🙏 Huge thanks to all the players who keep throwing ridiculous ideas at us.
Keep them coming — we’re turning your bad jokes into real features (without any testing, obviously).

💡 PS: Thanks, Dragonfly. Thanks to you, we’ve hit rock bottom — and we’re still digging. 🧑‍🌾

notes.title: 🎉 FUNFAIR BILLIONAIRE : OFFICIAL RELEASE APRIL 1st 🎉
notes.notes:
After months of chaotic development, unpatched bugs, and broken dreams…[b] FUNFAIR BILLIONAIRE is officially launching on Steam this April 1st![/b]

Is the game optimized?
👉 Nope.
Did we still add a brand new minigame to celebrate?
👉 YES. And it’s a banger.

[h2]🔑 THE KEY MASTER – MASTER OF NOTHING 🔑[/h2]

Ever wanted to rage over a minigame that requires pixel-perfect timing and soul-crushing disappointment?
Say hello to the Key Master.

Insert your virtual key, align it perfectly, press the button at just the right moment…
…and watch it bounce off like a sad noodle in slow motion.

A minigame so uselessly precise, it makes the claw machine look like a fair game.
Guaranteed to make you question your motor skills and your life choices.

[b]🎡 So yeah. The game is out. We made it. Kind of.[/b]
Between crash reports and weird physics bugs, we hope you’ll enjoy throwing your fake money into our cursed machines.

[b]📦 Buy it. Try it. Regret it.[/b]
And don’t forget to leave a review (something deep and poetic like "this sucks, I love it" will do).

Thanks to everyone who supported this janky little disaster, made with love, sarcasm, and a budget of exactly zero.
